name: Hasekura Airi
source:
Airi is a very intelligent and hardworking girl who happens to have mighty kicks and is also a tomboy. She’s the leader of the astronomy club. Airi is pretty much skilled in almost everything and is usually the only one who understands what [url=/c480]Nagisa[/url] is talking about.
